title: 第1章 见鬼的穿越第2章 崭新的开始
content_zh:
第一章 见鬼的穿越
我擦！！
秦岚用力的把手中的无线鼠标给摔了出去，这只罗技品牌的高档竞技茅斯立刻跟秦岚家的实木地板上来了个非常零接触，一瞬间破碎的零件四处飞散，洒满一地。高档实木地板显然是无辜的牵连者，面对可怜的遭受如此命运的鼠标，沉默的地板只能以自身凹下去一个明显的坑洼来表示哀悼。
秦岚很生气，非常生气。这是这个月来他第五次攻打王都洛阳，不过，这个相当恐怖的城市，再一次无声无息的吞没了秦岚的所有兵力，五百万铁骑兵，五十万床弩，十万冲车，四十万投石车，加上十来个满等级装备极品武将轮流强暴了洛阳城六个小时，竟然在最后一刻功亏于溃，系统在洛阳即将被占领的最后一刻重新刷出了全盛时期的满兵力……
没错，秦岚是在玩游戏。秦岚从小就是一个标准的三国迷，喜欢收集关于三国的所有一切，书籍，漫画，玩具，到现在的游戏。秦岚的电脑里，没有其它的东西，就全是三国游戏，三国群英传，三国无双，三国志，三国曹操传，赵云传……所有的游戏，他都通关无数次，熟到不能再熟悉。至于现在他玩的是一款堪称经典的网页游戏，叫做热血三国。这款网页游戏只出现了半年的时间，就疯狂的席卷了大江南北，宣传广告做的人尽皆知，只要是玩游戏的人，几乎没有不知道它的。秦岚当然是第一时间就冲进了这个游戏，半年的发展下来，他一步一步，从平民走到了现在的封王列侯，麾下更是已经拥有了近二十座城池，其中包括两个州城，八个郡城，十一个县城……现在就差最后那一步，只要攻打下首都洛阳，俘虏汉灵帝，逼他退位，热血三国就算是功德圆满。
可是……半年的积攒，在经过四次试探性的攻击之后，这一次秦岚派上了自己所有的实力，本以为可以一次性搞定，却没想到系统这样耍了他一道，所有兵力被全部清洗……下一次想要再来过，至少是一两个月以后的事情了。
掏出手机，秦岚把电话打到朋友那里，这个朋友正好是在做热血三国的管理员，就是大家俗称的GM,他在游戏中给了秦岚相当大的便利，所以秦岚才能够短短时间就发展到现在这种规模。系统最后刷出的满兵力明显不正常，这绝对是一个很大的BUG！！秦岚向朋友表达了自己的不满，并且要他跟上级要求赔偿。
但是，朋友的话，顿时让秦岚心凉了半截。原来，之前朋友给秦岚许多方便的时候，公司也知道，甚至默许这种行为，因为只有树立起几个强大的玩家典型，才能让更多的玩家增加投入，因为人都有攀比心理嘛，凭什么你可以这么厉害，我不行？？你能抓关羽？那我就要抓赵云！！……游戏公司的目的是赚钱，毫无疑问，秦岚一直以来，扮演的角色就是游戏公司的托，他确实也风光无限，游戏中排名前百的名将，关羽赵云曹操孙策……至少有六七十位全部集中在他的手中。但是游戏公司没有想到，秦岚发展的实在太过于快了，现在就试图攻打占领王城。毫无疑问，没有那个公司希望自己的游戏只有半年寿命，所以在秦岚攻打的最后关头，GM插手了，所以系统才会刷出满兵力……
秦岚沉默了一会之后，就挂掉了电话。
重新登入游戏，他把自己所有的名将分给了盟里的朋友们，名城也一个不留的全部让了出去，然后把自己的账号无限期休假了。
秦岚心灰意冷所以打算不玩了？？当然不是。从小秦岚就是一个不到黄河不死心的人，说他执拗，是一点都不过分，他只是想，既然你们想赚钱想多开一段时间，那我就等着好了……这段时间，我自己去买个服务器，自己建个游戏，自己去攻打洛阳，总没人干涉了吧。
今年正好三十岁的秦岚，正是一个男人一生中最鼎盛的时候，他现在开着一家自己的上市小公司，有车有房，女朋友不说天天换，至少上个礼拜你看到他身边的女人跟这个礼拜的绝对不会是同一个人。公司的事情走上正轨之后，他就聘请了一个职业经理人在打理，一般没有重要事情，他很少去公司，所以这才给他玩热血三国创造了条件，当然，丰厚的家底才是他一路风光的最根本原因。
只用了一天时间，秦岚就碾转联系到几个朋友，从他们手中高价买到了热血三国的源代码，之后又用了三天请人做成完整的服务器端，然后为了运行它，秦岚还专门跑去升级了自己的电脑，换成了目前市场上最强大的配置……终于，在折腾了一个礼拜之后，秦岚可以重新的进入热血三国游戏了。
只是，这一次，热血三国是单独为秦岚一个人所开，整个游戏里，只会有他一个玩家而已。
这样的游戏其实没有多大意思，秦岚本来就只是想攻打王城而已，所以没有也不打算慢慢的发展，玩私服还用足足半年的时间才能去攻打王城，那样简直是脑子进水……服务器正式架设完毕之后，他直接以GM的身份进入游戏的系统设置，调整所有的资源生产为正常的十倍，所有的房子能够容纳的人口为正常的十倍，所有的建筑建造速度练兵速度为正常的十倍，设置进入游戏时候的新手礼包，不管商城里有用没用的所有物品，全部送一千个，设置新手出来之后身上就拥有全珠宝9999个，设置初始资源为1000000，所有的初始库存为10000000。
设置好之后，秦岚兴奋的点下鼠标开启了服务端，王城洛阳！我来了！！
但是……砰！！伴随着一声巨响，眼前突然白光大盛，秦岚最后的念头是，“我擦，老子不是这么倒霉吧。”
————————华丽的分割线——————————
“他醒了！瞧他的手脚在动。”
“醒了就行，真是个没用的家伙，才打了他两下就晕了……我们走吧，别管这个废物了。”

秦岚感觉自己的头昏昏的，眼皮很沉重，怎么样都睁不开，耳畔传来的讥讽声音都是女孩子的声音，很年轻，但是听起来却似乎跟自己有关，手脚继续的动了几下，他这才发现自己现在似乎是趴在地上。
翻了个身让自己背部着地，顿时一股火辣辣的疼痛直彻心扉，秦岚猛力的睁开了眼睛，整个世界清晰的映进了眼瞳。
从来没有见过这样的蓝天，洁白的云彩低的似乎触手可及，空气中干净的让人感到不可思议。我这是到什么地方了？？秦岚勉强抬起了自己的胳膊，才发现上面有一条深深的血痕，就好像被人用鞭子抽过……看到这道深深的鞭痕，秦岚立刻知道自己背后的疼痛是怎么回事了！我擦，竟然被人用鞭子抽？？可是为什么我没有半点挨打的记忆？？我最后的记忆明明是……
这一瞬间，另外一个人的大量记忆突然瞬间涌入了秦岚的脑海……就好像是在看一部快进的电影，从醒世开始，直到刚才发生的事情，秦岚一点不漏的看了过来。
然后他明白了，他穿越了。
这是一个完全不同于秦岚原先世界的异位面，这个世界种族众多，高级智慧生命比比皆是，人类只是其中一种，这个世界发展的也不是科技文明，而是偏向于魔法文明。人类生活在牧图大陆的中央，有数十个国家，秦岚现在这个身体的名字，也叫秦岚，父亲秦不群是星岚帝国的礼部内行政使，一个有点实权，却影响力不大的官。
秦岚在家中排行老四，因为他上面还有三个姐姐，大姐秦晴，二姐秦衾，三姐秦笉，其中三姐秦笉和二姐秦衾还是双胞胎，而且大姐秦晴比秦岚只大四岁。按说，身为这一代之中唯一的男性，可以延续香火的秦岚应该备受宠爱才对……可是事实完全相反，秦岚的母亲不是秦不群的原配夫人，也不是第一个生下了大姐秦晴的二姨，而只是秦府中打杂的婢女，秦岚之所以能出现，是十多年前的某一天晚上秦大老爷在跟同僚应酬完之后，醉酒的结果。
尽管给秦不群生了个儿子，秦岚的母亲却没有落到好处，不但大夫人和二夫人联合起来反对秦不群纳她为妾，更是在平时无所不用其极的刁难她，这些苦楚她都为了儿子而默默的忍受了下来。秦岚倒是从刚出生开始就享受了很好的待遇，可是三岁时候的资质测试，他直接被判了死刑，专门负责测试的大师很为难的告诉秦不群，他的这个儿子完全是一个废物，既不能修行魔法，也不能学习斗气。
好吧，没有修炼的资质，做个普通人也好，只要够聪慧，未免就不能爬到他秦不群的位置上……秦不群本来还如此安慰自己，不过，看着三岁了还不会说话，而且时常呆愣愣的秦岚，他最终只是叹息了一声，完全放弃了这个儿子。
秦岚之后的日子，自然就不需要叙述，除了母亲，这个世界上没有人正眼看他，就连府中的下人，也是经常以欺负他为趣。
就是在刚才，二姐秦衾因为要练习骑马，不过才十七岁的她还没有那么高的个子可以直接爬到马身上，于是让这个废物弟弟趴在地上当垫脚石，结果却不知道为什么马自己移动了一下，导致秦衾差点摔倒，所以她就顺手狠狠的抽了弟弟几马鞭，结果把秦岚给抽晕了过去。
秦岚几乎不敢相信，自己竟然穿越到了这样的一个呆子+傻子+魔武废人的身上，有没有搞错啊，这个异世界，动不动就是什么剑圣，什么魔导师，什么巨龙的，自己什么都没有，怎么在这个世界活下去？？
虽然给了秦岚一个十六岁的身体，但是这个家伙一无是处，以后怎么办？？难道让实际上已经三十岁的秦岚以后饱受几个丫头和下人的欺负？？秦岚盯着眼前明显年轻白嫩了许多的手掌，脑海中却在苦思怎么办……离家出走？貌似这样做很愚蠢，以秦岚十六岁的身体出去，而自己对这个异世界一点都不熟悉，恐怕连工作都找不到，只有饿死。
手掌中，那一道红色的血痕，非常的刺眼。秦岚下意识的顺着它往手臂看了下去，突然看到右手手腕处，有一个熟悉的符号，看起来就好像一根短短的直线插进了一个圆圈中。这个符号实在太熟悉了，开机钮？？秦岚不敢置信的闭上眼睛，然后再睁开，没错，他没看错，手腕内侧确实有一个这个图案。
颤颤微微的抬起左手，秦岚用力的在那个图案上按了一下，因为碰到血痕，顿时痛得他呲牙咧嘴。
滴~耳边突然响起了开机提示声。不是吧，电脑也跟着我穿越了？它在那里呢？秦岚还在莫名其妙，一个机械合成声就已经在耳边响起，“系统检测中，请稍等……”
这个声音，在我体内？？秦岚这次注意到了，外面根本没有这个声音，也就是说别人根本都听不到，穿越的时候电脑融进了我的身体？？开什么国际玩笑？
“系统检测失败……发现系统异常，是否启动自我修复程序？”
……秦岚傻眼，怎么选择？面前没有选择的图案，他也没有鼠标和键盘。
“系统检测失败……发现系统异常，是否启动自我修复程序？”

“是！”见到系统又重复了一遍，情急之下，秦岚低声的喊了一句，不过……
“系统检测失败……发现系统异常，是否启动自我修复程序？”
“……”
“系统检测失败……发现系统异常，十秒钟之后自动进入自我修复程序。”
“自我修复程序启动，请稍等……”
“发现同类莫名程序，即将进行融合……”
“融合完毕……系统修复完毕，请重新启动。”
“融合完毕……系统修复完毕，请重新启动。”
“……”秦岚放弃了任何动作，呆呆的等待属于自己的结果。
“十秒之后自动重新启动。”
“滴！~系统检测中，请稍等……”
“系统检测完毕，准备进入。”

Chapter 1 The hell time travel
I wipe it! !
Qin Lan threw the wireless mouse in his hand hard. The Logitech brand's high-end competitive mouse immediately made zero contact with the solid wood floor of Qin Lan's house. In an instant, the broken parts flew everywhere and scattered all over the floor. The high-end solid wood floor was obviously an innocent party. Facing the poor mouse who suffered such a fate, the silent floor could only express its condolences by sinking an obvious pothole into itself.
Qin Lan was very angry, very angry. This was the fifth time he had attacked Luoyang, the royal capital, this month. However, this rather terrifying city once again silently swallowed up all of Qin Lan's troops, five million iron cavalry, half a million crossbows, one hundred thousand rams, four hundred thousand catapults, plus a dozen full-level and top-notch generals who took turns raping Luoyang City for six hours. However, they failed at the last moment. The system regenerated the full strength of its heyday at the last moment when Luoyang was about to be occupied...
Yes, Qin Lan is playing games. Qin Lan has been a standard fan of the Three Kingdoms since she was a child. She likes to collect everything about the Three Kingdoms, including books, comics, toys, and current games. There is nothing else in Qin Lan's computer, just the Three Kingdoms games, Heroes of the Three Kingdoms, Warriors of the Three Kingdoms, Chronicles of the Three Kingdoms, Cao Cao's Legend of the Three Kingdoms, Zhao Yun's Story... He has cleared all the games countless times and is so familiar with them. As for now, he is playing a classic web game called Three Kingdoms. This web game only appeared for half a year, but it has swept across the country like crazy. Everyone knows about the advertisements, and almost everyone who plays the game does not know about it. Of course, Qin Lan rushed into this game as soon as possible. After half a year of development, he step by step went from a commoner to the current king and lord. He already owned nearly twenty cities under his command, including two state cities, eight county cities, and eleven county cities... Now he was just short of the last step. As long as he attacked the capital Luoyang, captured Han Ling Emperor, and forced him to abdicate, the Three Kingdoms would be considered complete.
But... After half a year of accumulation, after four tentative attacks, Qin Lan deployed all his strength this time. He thought he could get it done at once, but he didn't expect the system to trick him like this, and all the troops were purged... The next time he wants to do it again, it will be at least a month or two later.
Taking out her mobile phone, Qin Lan called a friend. This friend happened to be the administrator of the Three Kingdoms, commonly known as the GM. He gave Qin Lan considerable convenience in the game, so Qin Lan was able to develop to its current scale in a short period of time. The final full force displayed by the system is obviously abnormal. This is definitely a big BUG! ! Qin Lan expressed his dissatisfaction to his friend and asked him to ask his superiors for compensation.
However, his friend's words immediately made Qin Lan's heart feel cold. It turns out that when friends gave Qin Lan a lot of conveniences in the past, the company also knew about it and even acquiesced in this behavior, because only by establishing a few strong player models can more players increase their investment, because everyone has a comparison mentality. Why can you be so good and I can't? ? Can you capture Guan Yu? Then I will arrest Zhao Yun! ! ...The purpose of the game company is to make money. There is no doubt that Qin Lan has always played the role of being the trustee of the game company. He is indeed very famous. The top 100 famous generals in the game, Guan Yu, Zhao Yun, Cao Cao, Sun Ce...at least sixty or seventy are all concentrated in his hands. However, the game company did not expect that Qin Lan had developed too fast and was now trying to attack and occupy the royal city. There is no doubt that no company wants its game to only have a lifespan of half a year, so at the last moment of Qin Lan's attack, the GM intervened, so the system would generate full troops...
Qin Lan was silent for a while and then hung up the phone.After logging back into the game, he distributed all his famous generals to his friends in the league, and gave away all the famous cities without keeping one, and then put his account on indefinite leave.
Qin Lan is frustrated and plans to stop playing? ? Of course not. Qin Lan has been a person who will not give up until he reaches the Yellow River. To say he is stubborn is not an exaggeration at all. He just thinks, since you want to make money and want to open for a while, then I will wait... During this time, I will buy a server by myself, build a game by myself, and attack Luoyang by myself. No one will interfere.
Qin Lan, who is exactly thirty years old this year, is at the peak of a man's life. He now runs his own small listed company, owns a car and a house, and changes his girlfriend every day. At least the woman you saw next to him last week will definitely not be the same as the woman this week. After the company got on the right track, he hired a professional manager to take care of it. Usually there was nothing important and he rarely went to the company, so this created the conditions for him to play the Three Kingdoms. Of course, his rich family background was the most fundamental reason for his success.
In just one day, Qin Lan contacted several friends and bought the source code of the Three Kingdoms from them at a high price. After that, it took three days to hire someone to make a complete server. Then in order to run it, Qin Lan went to upgrade his computer and replaced it with the most powerful configuration on the market... Finally, after a week of struggling, Qin Lan could re-enter the Three Kingdoms game.
However, this time, the Three Kingdoms was opened by Qin Lan alone, and he was the only player in the entire game.
This kind of game actually doesn't make much sense. Qin Lan originally just wanted to attack the royal city, so he had no intention of developing it slowly. It would take him half a year to attack the royal city even if he played on a private server. That would be a brain drain... After the server was officially set up, he directly entered the game's system settings as the GM and adjusted all resource production to ten times the normal level. The population that the child can accommodate is ten times the normal, the construction speed of all buildings is ten times the normal, the training speed of all buildings is ten times the normal, the novice gift pack is set when entering the game, and all items in the mall, regardless of whether they are useful or not, are given out one thousand. The novice is set to have 9999 full jewels after coming out, the initial resources are set to 1000000, and all initial inventories are 10000000.
After setting up, Qin Lan excitedly clicked the mouse to open the server, the royal city of Luoyang! I am coming! !
But...bang! ! Accompanied by a loud noise, a white light suddenly bloomed in front of his eyes. Qin Lan's last thought was, "Oh no, I am not so unlucky."
————————Gorgeous dividing line——————————
"He's awake! Look at his arms and legs moving."
"Just wake up. He's such a useless guy. He fainted after just beating him twice... Let's go and leave this waste alone."
Qin Lan felt that his head was dizzy, his eyelids were heavy, and he could not open his eyes. The sarcastic voices coming from his ears were all girls' voices. They were very young, but they sounded like they were related to him. He continued to move his hands and feet a few times, and then he realized that he seemed to be lying on the ground now.
Turning over so that his back was on the ground, a burning pain suddenly shot through his heart. Qin Lan opened his eyes violently, and the whole world was clearly reflected in his eyes.
I have never seen such a blue sky. The white clouds are so low that you can reach your fingertips. The air is so clean that it feels incredible. Where have I been? ? Qin Lan reluctantly raised her arm, only to find that there was a deep blood mark on it, as if someone had whipped it... Seeing this deep whip mark, Qin Lan immediately knew what the pain in her back was! I wipe it,He was whipped with a whip? ? But why do I have no memory of being beaten? ? My last memory is obviously...
At this moment, a large number of memories of another person suddenly flooded into Qin Lan's mind... It was like watching a fast-forward movie. From the moment he woke up to what happened just now, Qin Lan watched it without missing a beat.
Then he understood, he traveled through time.
This is an alien plane that is completely different from Qin Lan's original world. There are many races in this world, and advanced intelligent life forms abound. Humans are just one of them. The development of this world is not a technological civilization, but a magical civilization. Humans live in the center of Mutu Continent, with dozens of countries. Qin Lan's current body is also called Qin Lan. His father, Qin Buqun, is the internal administrative envoy of the Xinglan Empire's Ministry of Rites. He is an official with some real power but little influence.
Qin Lan is the fourth eldest in the family because he has three sisters, the eldest sister Qin Qing, the second sister Qin Fu, and the third sister Qin Fu. Among them, the third sister Qin Fu and the second sister Qin Fu are twins, and the eldest sister Qin Qing is only four years older than Qin Lan. Ordinarily, as the only male in this generation, Qin Lan should be favored... But the fact is completely opposite.
